title: Same thing an no make up or nail items
text:
I love the box but not any make up like what they show is not what you get. I hate deception in anything. I ordered 3-4months I ordered 2 times on accident for August.I was thinking of returning..Instread I cancelled thos order that I probably would have continued,gifted an referred..You dont getcwhat you pay for.You always get a mask so that's like $2.You get a small cream or primer "sample size"
You get a full size cleaser that may or may not be for your skin type.I got a small cream blush that wasnt that great.Add a nail polish,Some lipstick,Mascara etc.They give you samples like magazines do in paper an you can only wear 1 color.This is my personal opinion an a honest review cause I really wanted to continue my little treat each month.It may suit you so give it a try.Eniugh of mask an moisturizers for me though Good Luck.
